_comment: Copy and edit for a real overflow. Keys starting with _ are ignored notes.

rainfall._time_col: Date/Time column; or ["Date", "Time"] for split columns; guessed if omitted
rainfall._units: mm = depth per record, mm/h = intensity, tips = tip count (also set tip_mm)
rainfall.label: end

edm._exclude: monitor outages or periods when the overflow was not representative
edm._annual_alternative: if only annual returns exist, replace events_path/start_col/end_col with annual_path, year_col, count_col, duration_col

calibration._bounds: optional; drop q_pff_factor from bounds if q_pff_l_s is measured
